title: Experimental methodology used for testing in vivo adhesion of composite meshes for incisional hernia repair: a scoping review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36319-36330
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02062J, Review Article

Xu Zhang, Kaiyan Hu, Jing Xue, Zhe Wang, Yanbiao Jiang, Zhenyu Zou, Jinwei Yang, Mingyue Jiao, Shuo Yang, Yingmo Shen, Yusha Liu, Xingzhi Li, Wenbo Liu, Bin Ma, Jie Chen
This scoping review highlights significant methodological heterogeneity in animal studies evaluating anti-adhesive composite meshes for incisional hernia repair, underscoring the need for standardization in future research.
